preregistration_text.text: (4) POOLED SCORING, PRE-REGISTERED NOW (a separate script, three reviewers, written before the pooled numbers are read; the per-pair lane logs print per-pair checks only): P-A1.3: one cell per pair x c != 0, white-box over the nine pairs and transfer over its five pairs as a separate line; per cell, realised = the D-156 mean over draws and seeds of the per-draw FPR/target, predicted = the D-156 mean of the per-draw predicted FPR/target (unfloored primary, floored beside); D-177's accuracy line: share of cells within x1.5 and median |log(realised/predicted)|, n cells stated, zero predictions as misses; expectation as D-327: at least 80% within x1.5. P-A1.4: per draw and seed, the 4c Gaussian health flag at 2 / 0.5 against the realised class (realised paired ratio >= 2 or <= 0.5), pooled over the nine pairs and every c (white-box), sensitivity and specificity with the pair-cluster bootstrap of D-241 (6) (B = 5000, seed 520260925), by the estimator code of the D-255 pooled health-check summary applied unchanged; thresholds as D-327 (sensitivity >= 0.90, specificity >= 0.85).

bootstrap.kind: pair-cluster on the per-pair D-156 mean counts (D-241 (6), D-255)

choices: (a) P-A1.3's verdict line is white-box, unfloored (P-A1.3.scored: white-box primary, D-318 (9); the unfloored prediction primary, D-346 (2)(e)). The expectation (at least 80% within x1.5) is also tested, beside, on the white-box floored line, on the transfer line (D-346 (4)'s separate line, unfloored and floored) and on D-327 (4)'s literal cell set (pair x c != 0 x variant, both variants together, unfloored and floored); each line names its role.

(b) P-A1.3's predicted values are re-derived from each pair's predictions npz (the predictions record its A1 record names, by file and sha256, the JSON read as a registered input, D-297) exactly as phase3_a1.score derives them: per draw the seed mean of the per-seed predicted FPR over the target, unfloored, and floored per seed at 1/|E| (|E| = 1000, D-327 (1)), then the D-156 mean over draws 1..200. They must equal the A1 record's per-cell rows and cells and the predictions record's own 'predicted' block, else the scorer refuses. The realised values are recomputed from each A1 npz and must equal the record's.

(c) 'Every c' in D-346 (4) is read as every attacked c, c != 0 (D-327 (4): 'over (pair, c != 0, draw)'); the white-box line with c = 0 included is beside, not scored. P-A1.4's unit is (pair, c != 0, draw): 'per draw and seed' is read as 4c's per-draw statistics, each the mean over seeds of per-seed ratios (D-241 (2)), so the per-draw unit is the seed-mean flag; the records hold no per-seed flag.

(d) The thresholds apply to the pooled point estimates from the per-pair D-156 mean counts (the values D-255 quotes, 0.918 and 0.898); the pair-cluster interval is beside. A pooled rate with no cell of its class is undefined: holds is then None with the reason, not False.
(e) The direct reference ratio and the AUC rule are pooled beside by the same estimator, not scored (D-255 reports all three).

(f) 'One code block': the nine records' code sha256 maps and library versions must be identical (strict); their commits may differ (a push between two jobs moves SYNC_COMMIT without changing a hashed file) and are listed. The scorer refuses unless src/phase3_a1.py and src/phase3_a1_predictions.py in the records and in its own tree are the reviewed blobs (REVIEWED_SHA256: the files at 6647ac2, unchanged at fa1b4a0; it calls their accuracy line, confusion counts and grid); any other A1 code file that differs from this tree is listed. A relaunch of the A1 list must therefore keep fa1b4a0's code block (module docstring).
(g) The transfer line's pairs must be D-346 (2)(d)'s five; the c grid, draws, seeds and target must agree across the nine.

(h) D-170: each pooled line carries the per-pair flag the A1 records store (input_verification.flag) and its number of flagged cells; D-331 made D-168 final and its pinned record clears the flag of the judged pin-only inputs. No flagged or unflagged sub-line is formed (none is pre-registered).

P-A1.3.cells: pair x c != 0, per variant; realised: the D-156 mean over the draws of the frozen arm's FPR/target (the seed mean of floored per-seed FPRs); predicted: the D-156 mean of the per-draw predicted FPR/target, unfloored (primary) and floored per seed at 1/|E| (beside), re-derived from the predictions npz
P-A1.3.accuracy_line: D-177 (phase3_a1.accuracy): share within x1.5, median |log(realised/predicted)|, n cells; a zero prediction is a miss and counted (D-322 (4))
